name: Experience Co Limited
summary: Experience Co Limited, an adventure tourism and leisure company, provides tandem skydiving services in Australia and New Zealand. The company operates through Skydiving and Adventure Experiences segments. It also provides white water rafting, canyoning, helicopter and boat tours, reef tours, and snorkeling and diving in the Great Barrier Reef; rain forest tours; and hot air ballooning services. The company operates 16 skydiving locations in Australia and 3 locations in New Zealand; and an adventure hub in Cairns Far North Queensland. Experience Co Limited was founded in 1999 and is based in Sydney, Australia.
